texte.Faire cesser l'activité qui cause, préve: Ceasing the activity that causes, preventing potential impacts, and REMEDIATING the harm already caused.
texte.Faire cesser sa contribution, prévenir c: Ceasing its contribution, preventing the contribution to come, remediating ITS SHARE of the harm, and building its leverage over business relationships to prevent the rest.
texte.Faire cesser, prévenir et atténuer les i: Cease, prevent and mitigate adverse impacts
texte.Guide OCDE sur le devoir de diligence po: OECD Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Business Conduct (#)
texte.ISO/IEC # — management du risque de l'IA: ISO/IEC # — guidance on AI risk management
texte.ISO/IEC #:# — gouvernance de l'usage de: ISO/IEC #:# — governance implications of the use of AI
texte.Identifier et évaluer les incidences nég: Identify and assess actual and potential adverse impacts
texte.Il est interdit de suggérer que l'OCDE a: It is forbidden to suggest that the OECD endorses this use of the work.
texte.Ils sont conservés tels quels. Les fusio: They are kept as they stand. Merging them would produce a four-thousand-character example; rewriting them would invent a sentence the document does not carry.
texte.L'ancrage dans les organes, les structur: Embedding in the bodies, structures, processes and teams, so that due diligence happens in the normal course of work — taking account of the independence and autonomy that national law recognises for some of those bodies.
texte.L'estimation de la probabilité que l'inc: The estimation of the likelihood of the impact occurring.
texte.L'exemple ne s'applique pas à votre orga: The example does not apply to your organisation — and you must be able to say why. The examples that none of your groups covers already leave the calculation without your having to say so.
texte.L'implication COMMANDE le niveau de dili: Involvement GOVERNS the level of due diligence expected: causing requires ceasing AND remediating, contributing requires ceasing its share and building its leverage, being linked requires using that leverage. It is what caps the rate.
texte.L'incidence est rattachée à vos opératio: The impact is linked to your operations, products or services by a business relationship. The document notes that contribution or direct linkage, once the system is deployed, sold or resold, often goes with an unmitigated risk in the design or a high-risk end user.
texte.L'organisme CONTRIBUE à l'incidence: The organisation CONTRIBUTES to the impact
texte.L'organisme est LIÉ à l'incidence par un: The organisation is LINKED to the impact by a business relationship
texte.L'étape qui commande toutes les autres :: The step that governs all the others: with no impacts identified, qualified by involvement and prioritised, steps # to # have no object.
texte.L'étendue de l'incidence — combien de pe: The reach of the impact — how many people, what territory.
texte.La couleur du tiroir de ce module dans l: The colour of this module's drawer in the sidebar is not the OECD's blue, and no OECD mark is reproduced.
texte.La licence ne couvre pas le matériel de: The licence does not cover the third-party material present in the work.
texte.La mesure dans laquelle l'incidence peut: The extent to which the impact can be remediated — the limits on the ability to restore the people or the environment to their earlier situation.
texte.La part que les parties prenantes peuven: The share that stakeholders can verify. It creates nothing by itself and makes the rest enforceable.
texte.La priorisation sur la gravité et la pro: Prioritisation on severity and likelihood, when it is not possible to address everything at once. The four factors are rated on the “process” screen, and each calls for its written justification.
texte.La relation d'un organisme à une inciden: An organisation's relationship to an impact is not static. It changes with the situation, and with what due diligence brings down. The document says it the other way round too: an organisation that stays linked to an impact and takes no measure to mitigate it sees its direct linkage become a CONTRIBUTION over time.
texte.La source, sa licence CC BY # et les deu: The source, its CC BY # licence and the two notices it imposes, what the document excludes itself from, and what this module refuses to say.
texte.Le document attend qu'il passe devant :: The document expects it to come first: it is one of the most significant risks, and step # begins with it.
texte.Le document déclare lui-même que ses exe: The document itself states that its practical examples do not constitute an exhaustive check list.
texte.Le document note que plusieurs options p: The document notes that several options may be combined depending on the scale and context of the harm, and that effective remedy is context dependent.
texte.Le document s'en exclut expressément et: The document expressly excludes it and points to another OECD due diligence guidance.
texte.Le document se déclare « risk-agnostic »: The document declares itself “risk-agnostic” in order to stay evergreen: it names frameworks that list risks, it does not draw up the list. This module does not lend it one.
texte.Le logo, l'identité visuelle et l'image: The OECD's logo, visual identity and cover image cannot be used without express permission.
texte.Le seul endroit où quelque chose change: The only place where something changes for people. Everything else documents; this one acts.
texte.Le site porte une page /dsa qui expose l: The site carries a /dsa page that sets out the regulation; no module measures it.
texte.Le socle, et celui qu'un système de mana: The foundation, and the one that an existing management system — ISO/IEC #, ISO #, a CSR arrangement — most often supplies as it stands.
texte.Le taux dit la diligence déclarée. Aucun: The rate states the due diligence declared. No body issues an attestation against this guidance — unlike prEN #, which will carry presumption the day it is cited in the Official Journal.
texte.Le vert de ce parcours dit que ce qu'un: Green on this itinerary says that what a block expects is filled in. It does not say you are compliant: this guidance is voluntary: it implements two OECD recommendations and opens no presumption of conformity, at any date. No body issues an attestation against it.
texte.Les PME sont tenues à la diligence comme: SMEs are held to due diligence like the others. The document recognises that they do not have the same capacity — limited means, weaker leverage over business relationships, the cost of prevention — and that the measure is proportionate to their situation. It does not disappear.
